title: G2.5 - GitHub connector, CI evidence, and PR action
intent: Add IntegrationRun CI evidence production, structured PR-creation actions with parameter-bound approvals and effect receipts, and the GitHub connector binding, completing the external half of the trusted delivery loop.
scope: Implement the external half of the signature loop: integration runs producing CI evidence and verification results, governed PR-creation actions with parameter-bound approvals and effect receipts, and the GitHub connector behind an interface with a fake for tests.
non_goals: Live GitHub acceptance against a real repository (deferred to a user-provisioned environment; the connector is interface-bound and fixture-tested)
Webhook-driven automation; integration runs are recorded through governed commands in this slice
Fine-grained RBAC or delegation for approvals (approver = a human member other than the requester)
Emit outbox events for connector aggregates; the Timeline reads tables directly
Approve, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without independent review and explicit user acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Integration runs produce evidence and verification results: recording an integration run for a claim creates the immutable run fact, high-trust CI evidence, and a verification result whose verdict follows the conclusion

PR creation is a governed external action: an action request captures bound parameters; execution requires an approval whose hash matches, a valid derived acceptance on the latest submission, and a bound GitHub connection
Effect receipts bind external outcomes: an executed action records an immutable effect receipt with the external object id, url, and canonical request hash
The connector is behind an interface: the GitHub client is an interface with a fake used in tests; the real client is a thin REST wrapper
Contracts synchronized and verified: migration reconcilable, Go integration tests cover the loop with a fake connector, facade/read-model surfaces updated, i18n parity holds
accepted_by: Outcome Owner (browser acceptance delegated to Sisyphus; passed)
